mapper.sql: SELECT s.*,c.company_name AS customer_name,c.owner_id,o.dept_id AS owner_dept_id,o.real_name AS owner_name,b.title AS opportunity_title,q.quote_no,q.version_no FROM crm_sales_order s JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=s.customer_id JOIN crm_opportunity b ON b.id=s.opportunity_id JOIN crm_quotation q ON q.id=s.quotation_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_sales_order s JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=s.customer_id JOIN crm_quotation q ON q.id=s.quotation_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id
WHERE s.id=#{id} AND s.deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_sales_order WHERE quotation_id=#{quotationId} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_sales_order WHERE opportunity_id=#{opportunityId} AND status<>'CANCELLED' AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM crm_sales_order WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND deleted=0 AND status IN('DRAFT','CONFIRMED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_sales_order_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND active=1 ORDER BY sort_no
SELECT e.*,u.real_name AS actor_name FROM crm_sales_order_event e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE e.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY e.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_sales_order_item SET active=0 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no),0) FROM crm_sales_order_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_order_delivery WHERE order_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_shipment WHERE order_id=#{id})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_shipment WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='POSTED')
